title: CR60017: Cryogenic Heat Transfer
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Conductive Heat Transfer: Generalised solution of steady and unsteady
conduction equations: Heat transfer through composites and materials of
variable thermal properties: Analytical and numerical methods; Conductive Heat
Transfer Problem: Insulation, Heat leakage and Cooldown looses; Fins and Heat
Exchangers; Convective Heat Transfer: Analysis and Theories; Evaluation of heat
transfer and friction coefficients for Turbulent and Laminar flow; Forced
convection, Natural convection and near critical heat transfer regions; Two
Phase Phenomena: Physical description, Pool boiling, Critical heat flux,
Condensation, Evaporation, Pressure drop of Two Phase fluid, Forced convection
with Two Phase flow, Superfluid heat transfer, Kapitza Resistance; Radiation:
Theory, Shape factor, Radiative Exchange.
